note: RCW 9.95.204 ("Misdemeanant probation services -- County supervision") authorizes exactly two supervising entities -- DOC and counties contracting with DOC -- and its liability-shield clause names only "the department of corrections and its employees, community corrections officers, any county providing supervision services...and its employees, probation officers." No language authorizes contracting to private for-profit companies; the statute is silent on that category. (2026-07-09, tier3_absence Step 2 follow-up).
